utterances: Lao Wang, you absolutely must come to Sunday's event—I've already sworn to everyone you'll be there; don't you dare bail on us.
I genuinely can't swing it this time; I've got to take my mom to her doctor's appointment—it's all set in stone.
How am I supposed to handle this if you skip out? The whole crew has swapped shifts and is counting on you; for someone usually so dependable, this is a real letdown.
It's a bit of a bind with such last-minute notice—couldn't you show a little understanding?
This whole setup is tailored for you; skip it and the event collapses—talk about squandering everything.
Sigh, fine, I'll see if I can duck out briefly to pop by.
That's the spirit! And rope in a few extra hands while you're at it to keep things lively.
The Li family is hosting a gathering next month. As neighbors, you really should go and socialize. Everyone's looking forward to seeing you.
Sigh, I'm absolutely swamped. Not sure I can spare the time.
These get-togethers don't happen often. People will feel like something's missing without you.
Honestly can't squeeze out time. Maybe I could drop by later?
It's about nurturing old connections. Such a shame if you're not there.
Alright, I'll try to adjust my schedule.
It's for staying connected. Everyone's hoping you'll come.
Fine, I'll see what I can do. Just don't keep pushing me.
The elevator's been broken for a week. You should fix it urgently, or it's inconvenient for everyone.
Parts are out of stock. We'll handle it next week. Please wait.
Waiting too long shows your service efficiency isn't great. Is that reasonable?
Sourcing parts takes time. We're doing our best.
So we're supposed to share the repair costs? Well, we're considering not paying the fees then.
Paying fees is the owners' choice. Repair costs follow the rules.
Your approach to fairness is questionable. Compensation ought to be mentioned.
Compensation isn't realistic. Suggest discussing with management. Feel free.
You haven't been looking well lately, you should really go get checked at the hospital soon and not put it off.
Work's been crazy busy. Would it be okay if I went tomorrow instead?
Health is your most important asset, after all. Look at how conscientious Lao Liu is—he gets checked out for even trivial matters.
Wouldn't waiting a day or two for the checkup be fine? Besides, I'm feeling okay right now.
And yet, you're making me really worried. Could you possibly squeeze in some time to go today?
Sigh... alright, fine. I'll let my colleagues know.
Remember to bring the report from last time.
Hey, could you share that post for me on your Moments?
Just not feeling like sharing that kind of stuff lately. Handle it yourself.
Seriously? You won't even help with such a small thing? How stingy!
Who are you to tell me? Ask someone else if you want.
Ungrateful wretch! All my past kindness to you was wasted!
Are you insane? Who wants your phony kindness anyway?
Fine then. Don't expect any help from me at work going forward.
I'm moving next Saturday and I absolutely can't handle it alone - you've got to come help.
Sorry, I've got plans with an old classmate that day, probably can't make it.
When you moved last time, I came to help without hesitation.
How about I help you pack beforehand?
A move without a crowd just feels wrong - you had people over for your move too, didn't you?
Might only be able to stay briefly.
Whenever I remember us teaming up for that last move, it warms my heart.
Fine, I'll try to swing by and lend a hand.
How's that report coming along? If we keep dragging this out, the whole team's gonna suffer.
Ugh, it's brutal. Can't find all the research materials, progress is crawling.
Other teams submitted ages ago. They pulled all-nighters for the group - we can't be dead weights, right?
Nobody wants to hold things up... but this is seriously tricky...
I'll get Xiao Zhang to pitch in. Everyone's watching us now - gotta wrap this up properly.
Fine, I'll grind it out tonight and won't screw up the timeline.
Xiao Wang, need to discuss something. The project is entering a critical phase next week, and we're genuinely short-staffed. Regarding your scheduled leave, would you consider adjusting the timing?
Got it, boss... But this vacation was planned well in advance, and I've already paid the hotel deposit. It's a bit tricky to rearrange things.

I understand your situation. Unfortunately, project demands have surged unexpectedly, and we're critically short-handed. Would you consider shortening your leave duration, or perhaps taking it later? We'll definitely provide extra compensation.
Shortening the leave... I'll think about it. The main issue is that rearranging family plans would be quite a hassle.
It's true this inconveniences you. It'd be best if you could manage to overcome this. We really need your support to meet the tight deadlines. Let me know your adjusted plans as soon as possible.
Alright, I'll discuss it with my family and get back to you later.
Hey, I've got an unexpected business trip—could you watch my cat? Just three days, food and water are all set.
This week's brutal with my proposal deadline, really can't spare the time.
Honestly can't find anyone else—we're swamped wrapping up the project.
That's rough—I'm pulling overtime past 10pm every day.
Any chance you could squeeze it in? I can even drop the food off at your place.
Fine, I'll swing by during lunch break. Three days max, got it?
Perfect! Drinks on me when I'm back!
Hey, you're taking leave next week? Nonsense! Can't you see what state the project is in? Get back to work immediately!
Boss, I've completed all the procedures, and family arrangements are set. I've even finished my tasks ahead of schedule.
Bullshit! Who'll handle your workload? New requirements are piling up like shit! You're just ditching responsibilities—zero sense of duty!
I've handed everything over in advance. And per company policy, I'm entitled to this annual leave.
Screw the rules! This is an emergency! Cut the crap—you damn well better be at your desk Monday! Mess this up and you'll be fucking responsible!
...Got it. I'll be back.
I heard Xiao Chen goes for a morning run every day. Maybe you could give it a try?
Perhaps later. I'm not really a morning person.
He's lost ten pounds after keeping it up for half a year. Seems quite effective.
That's great, but I still prefer running at night.
How about you two go for a run together this weekend?
We'll see. Work's been quite hectic lately.
Alright. Feel free to reach out to him when you have time.
Lao Zhang, you must help with my son's job! After all we're fellow villagers, won't you even give me this face?
It's not that I won't help, but rules are strict now. Pulling strings could get me in real trouble.
Bullshit! How come you didn't say that when helping Lao Wang's son last year? You ungrateful bastard, forgotten your roots, have you?
It's different this time! Lao Wang's case went through proper procedures...
Cut the crap! If you refuse, don't even think about showing your face back home! The whole village will be backbiting you!
Alright, alright... I'll try... What a pain...
That's more like it. Remember to get it done by month-end. Don't you dare play tricks!
Oh man, working overtime every day is killing me, my bones are about to fall apart.
Everyone's having a tough time. Look at Xiao Zhang, he pushed through even with a fever last week—that kind of spirit really sets the tone for all of us.
But this is no way to keep going. What are we supposed to do down the road?
The project's wrapping up soon. Slacking off now would just waste all our hard work, wouldn't it? What a pity.
But this is endless—who can handle it?
You're a senior employee; you ought to lead by example for everyone at a crunch like this, or it'll be tough to keep the team on track.
Sigh... I'll try again for now. If I really can't cope, we'll see.
Hey, get my son into that elite middle school, got it?
Things are too tightly controlled these days, impossible to arrange.
Useless! What a waste of all those years as a department head!
You'd better watch your tone when speaking to me!
Help or don't - spare me the pretentious act!
Believe whatever suits you.
Screw this! Don't expect another word from me ever again!
Dude, my debt lawsuit is freaking out, I'm losing my mind here—you gotta help me figure this out ASAP!
Man, I'm swamped with this company project, meetings all day—can't handle your mess right now.
After all these years of friendship, you'd just watch me drown? Stop playing dumb and step up!
I'm clueless about debt stuff—what if my lousy advice screws you over?
Who hooked you up with a job when you got fired last year? Now I'm in deep shit and you're throwing me under the bus?
Ugh... fine, fine. I'll ask around when I get a minute—happy now?
Do me a favor and submit the report tomorrow? Your desk is right next to the print room—it’d be no trouble at all.
I’m swamped with my own work right now, not sure I can manage it.
The boss checks strictly—late submissions mean docked bonuses. Weren’t you quite willing to help Xiao Wang last time?
Sigh, my project’s a complete mess. I’d probably mess this up too.
Remember who lent you theirs for a whole week when your computer crashed? You’d refuse to do a little favor like this for a friend?
Fine, fine. But just this once—don’t ask me again.
You’re a lifesaver! Remember to submit before 2 PM—don’t drop the ball.
You're going to Guangzhou for business? The wife cakes there are a local specialty – you must bring some back for everyone.
My schedule is jam-packed; doubt I'll have time to buy any.
Lao Wang managed to bring some last time, so you can't just show up empty-handed, can you?
I'll try my best.
What do you think everyone will say if Xiao Li doesn't bring anything back?
If it's truly impossible, then never mind.
You wouldn't let everyone down, would you?
We'll see when the time comes.
I'm swamped with work, shouldn't you step up more as the mother?
I've been cooking after overtime myself—couldn't you come home earlier to help?
A child needs their mother most, and I'm breaking my back to provide.
Making money doesn't excuse neglecting our kid—you owe him time this week at least.
Fine, I'll spend time with him after this project wraps up. He'll understand.
Sigh... I'll just take him to the amusement park tomorrow then.
Hey Xiao Wang, could you find some time to handle the team event reimbursement? Everyone's counting on you.
Man, I'm swamped with work right now, and the reimbursement system is a nightmare to use. Can't manage it at the moment.
Come on now, teammates should support each other. Get this done and you can rest earlier.
The system's completely frozen. Could you give me a bit more time?
We're all struggling here, but without reimbursement sorted, the team event can't move forward.
Alright, I'll force myself to push through with it.
Good brother, knew we could rely on you.
I'll update you when it's done.
Everyone's furious! If you don't go apologize now, the team will collapse!
Isn't going now just begging for a scolding? Their phone's completely off.
Remember when Xiao Liu owned up last time? His bonus doubled. Why can't you step up like that?
Fine, I'll go.
Better mean it! Don't pull a Xiao Zhao and half-ass it, wasting months of our work.
This groveling is humiliating. Are we really that pathetic?
If this project fails, it's entirely on you! Every ounce of our effort will be for nothing!
Bro, the system crashed and I can't pay. Can I borrow your employee access to swipe the card?
Wouldn't we get penalized if caught?
Back when your mom was hospitalized, didn't I cover three night shifts for you? Now the project's going down the drain, and we'll all suffer!
But the surveillance is really strict...
Lao Wang paid for me last week without blinking an eye, and only your access works in our team. We're desperate to save this!
...Then hurry up and finish it, then void the order!
You're awesome! I'll split the end-of-month bonus with you 30-70!
But never again, alright?
Hey, how about hosting a party at your place this weekend? You're renowned for your hospitality after all.
Gosh, I've been swamped with overtime lately—just can't find the energy to go through all that.
It's just a casual get-together. Would you really turn down such a small favor? That's not very decent of you.
Well... just promise you guys won't touch my treasured collections, okay?
Of course we won't mess with them! Now cut the excuses and just agree already!
Alright fine, let's settle for Sunday afternoon then.
Now that's more like it! Knew I could count on you to come through.
Has your child's piano exam results come out? Our kid did exceptionally well.
Not yet, my child keeps complaining about being exhausted and refuses to practice.
That's unacceptable! Only perseverance brings results—it'd be such a waste to quit now.
It's mainly because the academic workload is overwhelming...
No matter how busy you are, you must prioritize talent development. All other kids are learning—surely we can't fall behind?
Fine, fine. I'll try to fit it in.
If you don't push harder now, there'll be no making up for it later!
I'm dealing with some legal issues - could you help me think of any solutions?
Could you tell me what happened? Let me hear the details.
It's a contract dispute - the other party refuses to pay what they owe.
For such cases, I'd recommend seeking professional legal help.
Do you happen to know any lawyers you could refer me to?
I'll ask around with friends and let you know if I hear anything.
Mom and Dad haven't been getting around too well lately. If you happen to be free this weekend, could you come keep them company?
Work's been crazy with this project deadline. I'll try to make time, but if I can't swing it I'll have a housekeeper help out.
They've been missing you and mentioned you several times. Just come whenever it works for you.
How about this: I'll take two days off next week to take them for their follow-up hospital checkup.
That'd be even better. I'll handle the cooking and meal deliveries.
Yeah, we can work out the specifics later.
Hey classmate, is this seat taken? I see belongings but no one here.
Oh, that's my spot, I just stepped out to take a call. What's up?
Thing is, library seats are pretty scarce. Seems you've been gone awhile with your stuff here. Mind if I sit temporarily? I'll vacate immediately when you return.
Hmm... alright. But I'll be back for my things soon. How long max will you stay?
About an hour or so. If you're coming back, I'll clear the seat for sure. Can't reasonably keep it vacant indefinitely waiting, right? Though entirely your call.
Sure, go ahead. I'll shift my stuff over. An hour works for my errands. Seat's wasted empty anyway—just give me a heads-up when you're done.
Freaking out! Last-minute shift tomorrow—my pup will starve! Could you lend a hand?
Back-to-back meetings all day tomorrow, can't barely squeeze out a minute!
He refuses to eat when alone—last time he literally threw up... Plus he responds best to you.
Ugh... my cat's been sick these past few days.
Remember last year when you traveled? I did your cat-sitting duty for seven days straight.
This... sigh!
Just one meal for the little guy! C'mon, old neighbors shouldn't stand on ceremony.
...Fine, I'll try to swing by during lunch break.
Hey, could you boost the video views for me right away?
Haven't had time for that stuff lately.
Stop the nonsense! Just do it when I say, quit stalling!
Could you at least speak more politely?
Why waste breath on trash? Boost it or get lost!
You're absolutely insane!
Suit yourself. Not like I need one more damn follower!
The kid's nodding off from exhaustion, and you're still not here.
Had to work overtime last minute, coming right away.
He's been looking forward to this for ages—what a letdown to wait like this.
I'll be more careful next time.
He's got school tomorrow, and we've already wasted so much time.
Really sorry about today, next time I'll come earlier.
Try to be on time going forward, so we don't have to go through this again.
The elevator's been out for a full week! The elderly can't get around easily, and you just watch?
It's a manufacturer parts shortage. We're calling them every day.
Other complexes get repairs fast. Are we special? Do the elderly deserve to suffer?
This time the stock is tight. We genuinely can't source the parts.
If the elderly starve and something happens, can the property management afford that responsibility? You should've had contingency plans!
We'll fix it immediately when parts arrive. We're anxious too.
You're always preaching about respecting the elderly, but when it counts, there's zero action. Does that sound right?
We've expedited the process. Everyone just needs to hold on a few more days.
Grandma needs care next month; would you be available?
I might be free in the latter half, but I need to confirm my work schedule.
It would be great if you could help out. I can take turns on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
I need to coordinate my child's pick-up, so I'll get back to you later.
No problem. I suggest prioritizing family responsibilities though.
We really should be involved, but we have to balance practical realities.
Understood. Just finalize by Friday.
Okay, I'll do my best to adjust.
Mom, Dad, you urgently need to get the social security sorted out. Do you even know the rules at your age?
What's the rush? I have no clue where those documents are.
After all we've done for you all these years, you can't even handle this? Has your conscience been eaten by dogs?
How dare you talk to me like that! You know damn well my legs aren't what they used to be!
Cut the crap! Find those papers by tomorrow, or don't expect me to care for you in your old age!
Fine, fine! I'll look for them, alright?
Should've just said that earlier. Such a drag!
Bro Zhang, any chance we could push back the payment a bit? I'm really in a tight spot right now.
Manager Wang, we agreed on settling this week. Our suppliers are breathing down our necks too.
I get your situation! But after all these years of friendship, remember when I covered the shipping costs for you last time...
...Then when's the earliest you can pay?
Before the 5th next month. You've always stood by your friends - I know you won't let me down when it counts, right?
Tch... fine, before the 5th then.
Thanks man! Knew I could count on you!
Professor, I've applied for a big data analyst position and need a recommendation letter. Could you write one for me?
Now you come to me? You never bothered to work hard before, and suddenly you remember to beg for a recommendation?
Sorry Professor, I've been swamped with lab projects and couldn't mention it sooner.
Pathetic excuses! As my student, you owe it to me to repay my efforts. You will take this position—stop being so damn picky!
But that role pays poorly, and I wanted to explore other options.
Shut your trap! Do things my way or kiss that recommendation goodbye. Now get the hell out of my sight!
If you're heading to the station tomorrow, could you grab me a ticket?
I'm a bit rushed tomorrow morning and might not have time to queue up.
No worries, I'll sort it out myself—you focus on your own things.
How about this: I'll try to snag a ticket for you on my phone?
That's so appreciated! But don't let it interfere with your important tasks.
No problem—if I get it, I'll text you on WeChat.
Boss, have you had a chance to consider the internship positions?
Still comparing candidates. Competition is fierce this time—several strong applicants.
But Xiao Wang is truly outstanding—top grades and solid experience, miles ahead of others.
We know Xiao Wang's capable, but company resources are limited. Need to be prudent with offers.
Have you lost your mind? With Xiao Wang's credentials, not offering him a spot is wasting talent!
Shut it! What do you know about company strategy? It's entirely up to me—take it or leave it!
Fine, your call. But don't come crying to me when this opportunity slips away.
I won't be back until seven. Could you possibly pick up my kid from school?
Actually heading to the supermarket anyway. Could swing by and bring them back.
That's really kind of you! Do I need to give you any documents?
Just the parent ID card should do. Still owe you for helping me with that delivery last time, actually.
Oh, that was nothing! I'll grab you that popular bubble tea tonight.
Really, no need to spend anything. So, five o'clock at the school gate for the kid, right?
Exactly! Thanks a ton, I'll treat you to dinner sometime!
Have you even watched the video competition entry yet? You're the only one in the whole team who hasn't.
Honestly swamped, got way too much on my plate.
Everyone's counting on you. Is it really appropriate to keep dragging your feet like this?
Have to watch it right now?
What else? Everyone poured their heart into this project – we're all waiting for your final say.
Sigh Fine, I'll take a look.
That's more like it. Gotta have that team player mindset.
Excuse me, Li Hua, that spot over there? Seems like I'd placed my bag earlier to save it. How come you're sitting there now?
Oh? Looked empty to me, seemed like it'd been vacant for a while, so I figured I'd sit down to read for a bit. Isn't hogging seats for too long kind of unreasonable anyway?

This seat is essential for my long-term study prep. Besides, doesn't the rule state seats are released if unattended for over half an hour? If everyone just takes seats like you're doing now, how is that fair to students like me who actually respect the reservation system? Rules must be adhered to by everyone.
But efficiently using resources matters too... Alright, I see your point. I'll move then.
Thanks for understanding. This way everyone can study with peace of mind and uphold order. Library etiquette relies on everyone doing what's expected.
Fine, I'll find another seat. Public spaces require everyone to be more conscientious.
I'm really worried about Xiao Wang's nonsensical posts flooding his social media. What if it ends up affecting our kid?
Is that really necessary? Why not just put him in a restricted group instead of blocking him outright?
The Zhao family blocked him ages ago, saying it's about being responsible parents. If you don't handle this and our child picks up bad habits, then who's to blame?
Sigh... doing this just doesn't sit right with me.
Isn't our family's peace and stability what matters most? Think about it—doesn't that make sense?
Fine, fine, I'll do as you say, alright?
Get it done quickly and let me know once it's done.
Done.
Professor, the model outputs are consistently wrong. Could you help adjust the parameters?
I'm buried in grant proposals lately. You need to work harder on your own—Xiao Li pulled an all-nighter fixing code just last week.
I'm truly stuck here. Could you spare a quick moment to look over the data?
Research requires independence. Take Xiao Zhang, for instance—he never asks me basic questions.
What should I do if this delays my graduation?
You're the student I worry about most in your cohort. Don't embarrass me in front of the faculty.
Fine... I'll try to figure it out on my own.
At the group meeting, you must present solid results. Don't let us down.
You simply must be at this ancestral ceremony—skipping it means breaking tradition.
I truly can't make it; something came up at my kid's school.
How could your kid's affairs outweigh showing respect to your elders? What will the whole family think of you?
Stay out of my business! You're always weaponizing filial duty.
Either show up for the ceremony, or consider our family ties severed!
So be it! Who's afraid of that!
Honey, this school district apartment has a prime location. It's so convenient for the kids' school, and Mom and Dad keep saying we should buy it. Let's just get it settled soon, okay?
Oh please, we don't even have enough for the down payment. The mortgage would be nearly 10,000 a month. We genuinely can't afford this.
Haven't Mom and Dad worked hard their whole lives just for our stability? Buying this place will put their minds at ease. Let's just push through this together.
Can't we make do with our small wedding apartment? Why on earth do we need such a big place?
Don't drag our feet about this. Everyone else has upgraded to new homes—are we supposed to settle for less? Try to figure something out.
Alright, alright. I'll think it over again, but that monthly payment is truly daunting.
Let's see what we can scrape together by month-end. We shouldn't let Mom and Dad worry.
Hey, grant me temporary access to the community gate now!
In such a hurry? The procedure's quite complicated on my end...
Cut the crap! Isn't helping friends basic decency? Are you even human if you're this reluctant?
Seriously? You had to curse that harshly?
Hurts, huh? Then open it ASAP! This is what being friends means!
Fine, fine... it's done! I swear, your moral blackmail is unreal!
Heard you're going to Guangzhou for business?
Yeah, leaving the day after tomorrow. Why?
Guangzhou sausages are famous. You ought to bring some back for all of us.
My schedule's packed. Doubt I can manage that.
Last time Xiao Wang brought tons. Everyone said what a great guy he was. Don't you want to show some goodwill?
Fine. I'll bring two packs.
There you go. Sharing is a virtue.
Yeah, got it.
Hey, you've got YouTube Premium, right?
Yeah, why? Wanna mooch off me?
Duh! What's our friendship even for? A real pal would've sent the login already - you seriously gonna be this stingy?
Hold up... you can't just hand this out to anyone. Where's your common sense?
Quit the holier-than-thou act! I covered your meal last time! Refuse and you're an ungrateful bastard - move it!
Fine, fine... you win. Account's on WeChat. Don't screw around with it!
Now we're talking! Appreciate it, man!
Cousin, my colleague urgently needs a loan, and for the guarantor, it absolutely has to be someone reliable like you. Could you do this favor?
Sigh, being a guarantor carries too much responsibility; I really don't feel comfortable with it.
He's genuinely in a tough spot—if even we relatives won't step in, who else possibly can?
I understand that, but honestly, I just can't take this on.
How about doing this as a personal favor to me? Our family always prides itself on strong bonds.
Please don't put it that way; it's making me feel overwhelmed.
Alright, I'll try to sort it out myself.
Hey, get me tickets for Jay Chou's concert tomorrow.
Get lost! I can't even snag one for myself!
Damn, just help me out! Is it gonna kill you with those fast fingers?
Not my problem. Get your own tickets.
Cheapskate! Fine, suit yourself.
Big talker! Why don't YOU get them instead of yapping here?
Useless! Can't even do this one damn thing.
Get lost! Take your whiny ass somewhere else!
How are you planning for the bride price? Will you need family support?
My savings aren't enough. I might need a loan, but the interest rates are quite high.
We can contribute fifty thousand. The rest you'll need to handle yourself.
Thanks, Dad! I'll borrow the difference from friends.
Try to gather it all before year-end. Don't let the wedding schedule slip.
Understood. I'll discuss the budget further with Xiaofang.
Just say if you need a guarantor, but don't let it interfere with your job.
Alright, I'll come home this weekend to talk details.
Hey buddy, could you shoot me a copy of the project quote for reference?
That's tricky - company confidentiality rules apply.
You don't trust our bond? Being this rigid is downright inhumane!
Please understand my position here - I'd face disciplinary action if caught.
As an old classmate, you ought to help me this once - consider it returning that favor from back in the day.
Well... let me figure something out.
Professor, I've applied for a data analyst position and need a recommendation letter. Would you be willing to help?
Now you tell me? You've been slacking off all along and expect me to clean up your mess?
I've been swamped with lab work and couldn't mention it earlier.
Bullshit! Forget about this position. Even if I wrote it, it'd be useless.
I'll try to find other opportunities then.
Suit yourself. Don't count on me.
Supplies are being distributed this afternoon. Would you like to help?
I'll see how my schedule looks. I'll head over after finishing my current tasks.
Okay, call me when you're going and I'll get things ready for you.
Good. I might need your help sorting the labels for the stacked supplies.
No problem. Where are the labels? I'll grab them first.
They're next to the warehouse. Let me know when you have them.
Got it. I'll call you as soon as I'm ready.
Alright. We'll catch up later.
Could you sign in for me at tomorrow morning's meeting?
I'm afraid that won't work—I've got a client meeting scheduled.
Is everyone in this family so heartless? This is your responsibility, understand?
Don't be like this, I'm truly stuck between a rock and a hard place.
Family comes first, right? Shouldn't decent people show some gratitude?
Well... I'll shuffle my schedule then.
That's more like it. Get there early—don't be late.
Hotel expenses are capped at 200 yuan. Any overage gets deducted from your paycheck. Got it?
Are you out of your mind? Even budget chains cost more than that!
Take it or leave it! Can't afford it? Go sleep under a bridge. Think this is a charity?
Was that 'charity' when you booked five-star suites for your mistress?
Looking to get fired? I'll have you terminated right now!
Do it! Let's see what talent your pathetic excuse for a boss can hire!
Pack your things tonight, you good-for-nothing! You're done here!
I'm definitely gonna be late for clock-in again tomorrow! Do me a solid and punch my card for me!
What if we get caught and fined? This feels way too risky.
Last time you took leave, I covered your report! What's wrong with helping out between good friends?
But the surveillance is super strict this time. I'm afraid we'll get busted.
Making excuses over such a tiny favor? How can you even call yourself a friend? Even colleagues help each other out!
Alright, alright! Just this once. Never again!
Thanks man! I'll buy you a drink sometime!
Lao Wang, you have to help with this guarantee—after all these years as buddies, how could you just stand by and do nothing?
Lao Li, I'm not making excuses, but if this goes wrong it could cost me my head—I just can't shoulder this responsibility.
Seriously? Does our friendship count for nothing? If that's how it is, then all I've done for you before meant zilch!
Don't paint me into a corner—you're basically forcing me to make a huge mistake!
If our roles were reversed, I'd jump in without hesitation. But now it's my turn and you're dragging your feet—what kind of friend is that?
I'm truly sorry, but this is beyond me. You can't expect me to take the fall for this.
Forget it. I must've been blind to call you a friend. Don't you dare come crawling to me next time you're in trouble!
I'm going on a three-month business trip. Could you look after this pothos plant at your place?
No problem. Is the balcony okay?
Thanks! Let's grab a fancy meal when I'm back!
It's been over four months now. When are you taking the plant back?
I've been swamped lately. But look how thriving the leaves are with all that sunlight at your place...
